# Vimeo

> > All-in-one video platform for hosting, streaming, live events, and on-demand content distribution

Vimeo provides professional video hosting, streaming, and distribution tools for creators and businesses. The platform supports live streaming, video-on-demand, enterprise video solutions, and independent film distribution through Vimeo On Demand.

## Key Topics

## Platform Overview

- [Vimeo - All-in-One Video Platform](https://vimeo.com/): Homepage for Vimeo's all-in-one video hosting and streaming platform

## Content & Discovery

- [Categories on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/categories): Browse video content by category including animation, music, and films
- [Browse | Vimeo On Demand](https://vimeo.com/ondemand/browse): Browse and rent independent films and series on Vimeo On Demand

## Live & Events

- [Vimeo Events, Live and On-Demand](https://vimeo.com/events): Live and on-demand events, webinars, and video conferences platform

## Support & Troubleshooting

- [Troubleshoot player error messages – Vimeo Help Center](https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/articles/12425812280081-Troubleshoot-player-error-messages): Guide to resolving Vimeo player errors and streaming issues
